item.title: Defect TQFTs, the Generalized Cobordism Hypothesis, and Algebraic $K$-Theory
item.description: arXiv:2610.41105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By constructing a fully dualizable category $\mathrm{Bord}^{\mathcal{C}}_n$ as the left adjoint of the forgetful functor, we state a generalized cobordism hypothesis. As a corollary, we establish a generalized Pontryagin-Thom isomorphism that gives a geometric interpretation of higher algebraic $K$-theory using cobordism classes of framed manifolds and stratified spaces decorated by categorical string diagrams, which we call lasagnas. For finite-dimensional vector spaces over a field, these decorations are branched local systems. We also examine low-dimensional representatives, including $K_1$, Steinberg-group presentations of $K_2$, and fillings related to the Steinberg relation, providing a more explicit construction of Ghys' manifold.
item.dc:creator: Keyao Peng

item.title: The coanalyticity of the reduced K-theory on modules over free tensor algebras of dualizable t-categories
item.description: arXiv:2610.41566v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we formulate Land-Tamme's $\boxtimes$-construction and $\odot$-construction for continuous exact monads on dualizable stable $\infty$-categories, and establish the behaviour of localizing invariants on pushouts of left modules over continuous exact monads on dualizable stable $\infty$-categories. Combining the Land-Tamme theory of continuous exact monads with the theory of analytic functors in Goodwillie calculus, we show that the reduced K-theory on modules over free tensor algebras of dualizable t-categories is modified 1-coanalytic or modified 2-coanalytic, depending on the coconnectivity of the base algebras. In particular, this answers Efimov's question concerning coanalyticity in the affirmative.
item.dc:creator: Li He

item.title: Descent and Decomposability of Algebras of Exponent 2 in characteristic 2
item.description: arXiv:2610.40673v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We define an invariant of central simple algebras of degree 8 and exponent 2 over fields of characteristic 2. It is built from the discriminant Pfister forms of symplectic involutions, takes values in a quotient of the third part of the graded group associated to the fundamental filtration of the Witt group of quadratic forms, and vanishes on tensor products of three quaternion algebras, thus giving a necessary condition for decomposability. Variants of the consctuction yield necessary and sufficient conditions for a biquaternion algebra to descend from a quadratic extension of the base field, and for a quaternion algebra to descent from a biquadratic extension that is not purely inseparable. Our results extend known results both in characteristic 2 and in characteristic different from 2, see the introduction. Using residue maps for quadratic forms, we show that these invariants do not vanish in general, and we give an explicit central simple algebra of degree 8 and exponent 2 with nonzero invariant, which is therefore indecomposable. As explained in the appendix, the purely inseparable case is quite different; in particular, a quaternion algebra descents if and only if its Brauer class also does.
item.dc:creator: Anne Qu\'eguiner-Mathieu, Jean-Pierre Tignol

item.title: Homotopy in enriched functor categories: Frobenius exact structures and weak Serre functors
item.description: arXiv:2610.40746v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Let $(\V, \otimes, I,[-,-])$ be a closed symmetric monoidal category with finite (co)limits. Assume that $\V$ is weakly idempotent complete and additive. For a given small $\V$-category $\A$, we investigate sufficient conditions on $\A$ under which the ordinary category $[\A, \V]_0$ of $\V$-functors from $\A$ to $\V$, equipped with the exact structure $\mathcal{E}_{\textrm{lowt}}$, is a Frobenius exact category,and hence, induces a triangulated stable category. The exact structure $\mathcal{E}_{\textrm{lowt}}$ encompasses the degre-wise trivial exact structure on categories of $N$-chain complexes and $m$-periodic chain complexes, with terms in a variety of settings, including left $R$-modules, quasi-coherent sheaves on a scheme, and Banach spaces. We subsequently address the question of describing abstract left and right homotopy relations in $([\A, \V]_0;\mathcal{E}_{\textrm{lowt}})$ in terms of families of morphisms defined objectwise, as in the cases of chain-homotopy and relative homotopy relations. To this end, we introduce the notion of left/right-weak Serre $\V$-functors on $\A$, and investigate their relationships with the classical Serre functor relative to a commutative ring $k$.
item.dc:creator: Sinem Odabasi

item.title: Tate and Artin--Tate Motivic Tensor-Triangular Geometry
item.description: arXiv:2610.40806v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We compute the Balmer spectra of geometric Tate and Artin--Tate motives with $\mathbb{F}_p$-coefficients over any field whose characteristic differs from $p$. For Tate motives, we find the bigraded comparison map to be a homeomorphism to the homogeneous spectrum of the motivic cohomology of the base field. For Artin--Tate motives, we describe the spectrum as a gluing of the spectrum of Artin motives computed by Balmer--Gallauer with the punctured Tate spectrum. We determine all specialisations between these pieces and the resulting topology. Under the hypothesis that the spectrum of rational Tate motives is a singleton, we also compute the integral Tate spectrum after inverting the exponential characteristic of the base field. As a consequence of our results, we identify the punctured Tate spectrum as an open subspace of the spectrum of the category of geometric Voevodsky motives, and draw some conclusions concerning the latter. Finally, we include an appendix where we define generalised periodicity in the context of tensor-triangular geometry, and explore its applications in motivic settings.
item.dc:creator: Jean Paul Schemeil, Fraser Sparks

item.title: Derived products and completion defects of inverse limits
item.description: arXiv:2610.34022v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We compute derived products and inverse limits in Grothendieck categories by exact coresolutions. For the product of $r$ doubled affine lines over $B[s]$, where $B$ is any nonzero commutative ring,the exact dimensions of products, epimorphic countable limits, and arbitrary countable limits are $r$, $r$, and $r+1$. We identify the top derived functors for every $B$-module of coefficients. Both obstruction modules contain the countable reduced product as a natural $B$-module direct summand, and a formal-series map relates them by an explicit cokernel sequence. A relative cofree coresolution gives degree shifts over an arbitrary Grothendieck category and computes the localization defect for arbitrary locally nilpotent diagrams. We also construct transfinite scalar extensions preserving a prescribed kernel and its derived limit;these give nonzero completion defects beyond any fixed ordinal.The general epimorphic top-degree vanishing question is not settled by these constructions.
item.dc:creator: Rui Zeng (Sichuan Normal University), Guocheng Dai (Sichuan Normal University)
